confirmed.interactionCheckHook: Base update calls integrator104420 at103c44, then, if flags+150bit1,+154bit3,!bit4, calls motion vtable+c8 (59f220), setting+154bit4 on true. Hook is an interaction predicate, not rollback: controller+28 tag84; actor+464==2; instance actor+650, FNTR lookup65be10 using instance+138; group actor+658 in FNTR+2c8 stride64, slot actor+65a stride136. Positive slot+50 compares full XYZ distance from saved actor+65c anchor; <=radius² returns true. Otherwise requires slot+54>0,count+74>1 and successful vector candidate helper656d70 then657970. confirmed.fntrPlanarAxisConversion: Helper657dc0 scales local X/Z by writable globals141a1e608/141a1e610 and rotates onlyXZ: rotation+1 yields(Z,-X), secondary instance+1d8==-1 yields(-X,-Z), rotation-1 yields(-Z,X), otherwise(X,Z). Adds grid origin5b48d0(instance+1c8); Y is localY+originY+instance+18c. It establishes Y as perpendicular coordinate to this XZ interaction plane, not positive-up/gravity or camera handedness.
confirmed.nativeGridPositionUnits: 5b48d0 returns X=(int32gridX+0.5)*scaleX, Z=(int32gridZ+0.5)*scaleZ, Y=-float(runtimeIntTable[normalizedGridY])-f32(0.01) if index valid else0.
